lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun te gun mil paaeeai je satigur maahi samaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with a virtuous person, virtue is obtained, and one is immersed in the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋੁਲਿ ਅਮੋੁਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਿ ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: moul amoul na paaeeai vanaj na leejai haat ||
lines.translation: Priceless virtues are not obtained for any price; they cannot be purchased in a store.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa tol hai kabahu na hovai ghaat ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their weight is full and perfect; it never decreases at all. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਭਰਮਸਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam vihoone bharamasahi aavahi jaavahi neet ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they wander around, continually coming and going in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਇਕਿ ਢੀਲਿਆ ਇਕਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik baa(n)dhe ik dheeliaa ik sukheee har preet ||
lines.translation: Some are in bondage, and some are set free; some are happy in the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa ma(n)n lai sach karanee sach reet ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, believe in the True Lord, and practice Truth, through the lifestyle of Truth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te giaan paaiaa at khaRag karaaraa ||
lines.translation: From the Guru, I have obtained the supremely powerful sword of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗੜੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa bhram gaR katiaa mohu lobh aha(n)kaaraa ||
lines.translation: I have cut down the fortress of duality and doubt, attachment, greed and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasiaa gur sabad veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord abides within my mind; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jam mat ootamaa har lagaa piaaraa ||
lines.translation: Through Truth, self-discipline and sublime understanding, the Lord has become very dear to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa sach sirajanahaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Truly, truly, the True Creator Lord is all-pervading. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa raagaa vich jaaneeai bhaaee sabade kare piaar ||
lines.translation: Among the ragas, Kaydaaraa Raga is known as good, O Siblings of Destiny, if through it, one comes to love the Word of the Shabad,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat siu milado rahai sache dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: and if one remains in the Soceity of the Saints, and enshrines love for the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਲਾ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu mal kate aapanee kulaa kaa kare udhaar ||
lines.translation: Such a person washes away the pollution from within, and saves his generations as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਵਿਡਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunaa kee raas sa(n)grahai avagan kadhai vidaar ||
lines.translation: He gathes in the capital of virtue, and destroys and drives out unvirtuous sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak miliaa so jaaneeai guroo na chhodai aapanaa doojai na dhare piaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone is known as united, who does not forsake his Guru, and who does not love duality. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਉ ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar dekhau dar marau bhai terai dar naahi ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the world-ocean, I am afraid of death; but if I live in the Fear of You, God, then I am not afraid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sa(n)tokheeaa naanak bigasaa naai ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am content; O Nanak, I blossom forth in the Name. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਚਾਲਸਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaR bohithai chaalasau saagar laharee dei ||
lines.translation: I get on board the boat and set out, but the ocean is churning with waves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਸਚੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaak na sachai bohithai je gur dheerak dei ||
lines.translation: The boat of Truth encounters no obstruction, if the Guru gives encouragement.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਉਤਾਰੀਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit dar jaai utaareeaa gur disai saavadhaan ||
lines.translation: He takes us across to the door on the other side, as the Guru keeps watch.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai daragah chalai maan ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if I am blessed with His Grace, I shall go to His Court with honor. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਕੰਟਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihaka(n)tak raaj bhu(n)ch too guramukh sach kamaaee ||
lines.translation: Enjoy your kingdom of bliss; as Gurmukh, practice Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai takhat baithaa niaau kar satasa(n)gat mel milaaee ||
lines.translation: Sitting upon the throne of Truth, the Lord administers justice; He unites us in Union with the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa upades har jaapanaa har siu ban aaee ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, through the True Teachings, we become just like the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai sukhadaataa man vasai a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||
lines.translation: If the Lord, the Giver of peace, abides in the mind, in this world, then in the end, He becomes our help and support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har siu preet oopajee gur sojhee paaee ||2||
lines.translation: Love for the Lord wells up, when the Guru imparts understanding. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolee bhoolee mai phiree paadhar kahai na koi ||
lines.translation: Confused and deluded, I wander around, but no one shows me the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poochhahu jaai siaaniaa dukh kaatai meraa koi ||
lines.translation: I go and ask the clever people, if there is there anyone who can rid me of my pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saachaa man vasai saajan ut hee thaai ||
lines.translation: If the True Guru abides within my mind, then I see the Lord, my best friend, there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀਐ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man tripataaseeai siphatee saachai naai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my mind is satisfied and fulfilled, contemplating the Praises of the True Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape karanee kaar aap aape kare rajaai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Doer, and He is the deed; He Himself issues the Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kis hee bakhas lae aape kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives some, and He Himself does the deed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chaanan gur mile dukh bikh jaalee naai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, receiving the Divine Light from the Guru, suffering and corruption are burnt away, through the Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੂ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa vekh na bhul too manamukh moorakhaa ||
lines.translation: Don't be fooled by gazing at the riches of Maya, you foolish self-willed manmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਲਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalaee sabh jhooth darab lakhaa ||
lines.translation: It shall not go along with you when you must depart; all the wealth you see is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਲਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dh na boojhaee sir oopar jam khaRag kalakhaa ||
lines.translation: The blind and ignorant do not understand, that the sword of death is hanging over their heads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare jin har ras chakhaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are saved.
